beats.name: hook
beats.said: Hero cut gaps into a railroad at fixed spacing.
beats.shown: Hero crouches on the track with a saw and a locomotive approaching, then a camera fly-out along the canyon.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Two companies race a railroad along a bottomless canyon; winner takes the country's trade; he is the youngest engineer.
beats.shown: Fast canyon fly-bys, bridge, crane, desert, tycoon on stage, workers on a beam.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: The boss spots the gaps, turns purple with rage and shouts, but he refuses to close one.
beats.shown: Boss in yellow vest goes purple, steam puffs, shouts; handshake gag; hero stays calm.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Rival lays smooth rails and wins; quiet trains glide while his clatter; papers mock it; everyone switches.
beats.shown: Conductor, trestle, lounge car, window man, newspaper reader, station crowd.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: Summer heat shrinks his gaps from a coin width to a sheet; the boss is thrilled.
beats.shown: Calendar and thermometer, calipers on a rail that heats pink to yellow, hero and boss smiling.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: Rival's rails groan and push in the heat; on the hottest day his gaps close.
beats.shown: Long straight track, glowing rails, parasol character, hero, rail ends touching.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: The perfect railroad buckles like a snake just as a train rolls on.
beats.shown: Bridge fly-in, train on a wavy track, falling loco, explosion, two characters watching.

generation_evidence.observation: Steel arch bridge with lamps and rails stays rigid and consistent during a fly-in; rail geometry and perspective are clean.
Same hero model, cap stripes and colours reappear in every scene; limbs keep their length.
Newspaper text 'The Red Mesa Herald' is crisp, stable and readable across the take.
Calendar, thermometer and calipers stay readable; the coin gap grows smaller consistently; rails change colour smoothly.
Cliff walls show horizontal stripe or streak texture on the lower canyon, and the purple chasm water looks smeared.
The fireball looks like a volumetric VFX; the characters are then composited at the lower corners.
